messages:
Ari: Heads up — ACME is asking to lock an enterprise commit next quarter but they want firm throughput guarantees. We need sizing + pricing for 24/7 traffic + a POC window.
Devon: Can you paste their QPS and avg token/response? that drives GPU count.
Ari: Their doc says ~150 rps peak, avg 40 tokens per response, 99th latency target <300ms. POC will be 2 weeks with production-ish traffic.
Priya: For 150 rps, rough calc: if model is ~7B and we aim p99 <300ms we need ~6 reserved GPUs on our Dedicated pool with small batching; that assumes KV caching hits ~30% and no heavy regen.
Olga: Pricing ask from finance: they want committed discount tiers and burst credits for spikes. can we give a commit for 6 reserved GPUs + 20% burst buffer?
Devon: 20% burst is reasonable as burst credits — we can map to autoscale policy: min=6, target=6, burst=+2 for short term. If steady grows -> scale plan.
Ari: They also asked about failover to a cheaper model during overload. Is that supported?
Priya: Yes — smart routing can fallback to a quantized 7B or 3B variant. We should include canary and rollback rules for quality. recommend default fallback to model-7b-q4 then model-3b if needed.
Kevin: Security blocker: ACME requires KMS-backed key separation and audit logs for all inference requests in the POC. Need VPC peering + SAR around logs retention. Who owns the approach?
Devon: We'll propose Private deployment for POC (control plane w/ customer-managed VPC) — covers KMS + VPC + logs retention. Note: extra ops time and license fee.
Olga: Sales needs a line item: Dedicated baseline + Private deployment add-on + burst credits. Also a note for SLA — they want 99.9% with penalties.
Priya: Operational note: recommend a canary rollout for commit activation: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with synthetic smoke tests. Include autoscaler cooldowns (scale-out 30s, scale-down 10m).
Devon: For POC tests — run the load harness: 2 concurrent clients, 150 rps sustained, step up to 250 rps for 10m to exercise burst. Example load command:
```bash
vegeta attack -rate=150 -duration=1m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report
```
Ari: Good. ACME also asked about token cost modeling — can we provide per-1k-token unit cost at committed discount?
Olga: I'll add pricing matrix: base unit price, committed discount %, private deployment fee, and burst credit pricing.
Kevin: One more security item: they want proof of isolation during multi-tenant runs. We should include network diagrams and tenant isolation doc.
Devon: I'll draft the sizing playbook and isolation appendix. Plan: deliver initial doc + pricing sketch by EOD tomorrow, then run POC infra readiness call w/ ACME on Tue.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: infra quota verified: Dedicated pool capacity check OK. Reserved GPUs available: 8.
Ari: Perfect, thanks — will sync w/ ACME and ping back with any changes. :thumbsup:
